title: 0117_order_items_fk.sql

spec.text: Every order_items.order_id that is set must reference an existing order, and deleting an order must delete its items. About 3k orphan items left by a 2023 bug should be removed as part of this change. Writes to both tables must not be blocked for more than a few seconds.

context: PostgreSQL 16. order_items has ~120M rows and takes inserts continuously; orders has ~30M. The migration tool runs each file inside one transaction. order_items.order_id is nullable: rows with NULL order_id are gift-card top-ups and must be kept. Existing order_items indexes: primary key (id) and (product_id).
